capabilities: open or create the current month's note
name notes with a preset or custom date format
set the folder new monthly notes go into
apply a template note with date and time placeholders
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: This project attempts to replicate the features of the core Daily Notes plugin without adding additional features.
motivation: The author wanted a small, simple replication of the core Daily Notes behavior for months, without the extra features other similar plugins add.
problem: Obsidian's core Daily Notes only covers daily notes, and other periodic-note plugins add complexity the author wants to avoid.

relations.evidence: attempts to replicate the features of the core Daily Notes plugin

summary: Minimal monthly-notes plugin that creates or opens the current month's note via a ribbon icon or command.
